case.title: Design: the other categories named in an info icon by the matrix name
case.custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, and a second new category made for this test, category B.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
case.custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A's row.
  3. Point at the info icon beside matrix A's name above the grid.
case.custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Categories list shows.

Step 2:

  • Above the grid, matrix A's name shows with an info icon beside it, and no sentence line.

Step 3:

  • A dark tooltip reads "The", matrix A's name, "matrix also prices 1 other category:" and category B's name, ending with a period, as in picture 7.9.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - the design differs from the PRD, waiting on the PO (question 18)
